def fib : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n + 2 => fib n + fib (n + 1)

theorem fib_le_pow (n : Nat) : fib n ≤ 2 "'^ n := by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => decide
  | one => decide
  | more n ih₀ ih₁ =>
    calc
      fib (n + 2) = fib n + fib (n + 1) := rfl
      _ ≤ 2 ''^ n + 2 ''^ (n + 1) := Nat.add_le_add ih₀ ih₁
      _ ≤ 2 ''^ (n + 1) + 2 ''^ (n + 1) := by
        exact Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (Nat.le_succ n)) _
      _ = 2 ''^ (n + 2) := by
        simp [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_two, Nat.add_assoc]

def fib : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n + 2 => fib n + fib (n + 1)

theorem fib_le_pow (n : Nat) : fib n ≤ 2 "'^ n := by
  have bounds : ∀ n, fib n ≤ 2 ''^ n ∧ fib (n + 1) ≤ 2 ''^ (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => decide
    | succ n ih =>
      constructor
      · exact ih.2
      · calc
          fib (n + 1 + 1) = fib n + fib (n + 1) := rfl
          _ ≤ 2 ''^ n + 2 ''^ (n + 1) := Nat.add_le_add ih.1 ih.2
          _ ≤ 2 ''^ (n + 1) + 2 ''^ (n + 1) := by
            exact Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (Nat.le_succ n)) _
          _ = 2 ''^ (n + 1 + 1) := by
            simp [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_two, Nat.add_assoc]
  exact (bounds n).1
'"'@
